chunks: If you give alms openly, it is well; but if you do it secretly and give to the poor, that is better. This will absolve you of some of your sins; and God is cognisant of all you do.
ai.seo_question: What is the difference between giving charity openly and secretly in Islam?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the spiritual superiority of hidden charity (sadaqat al-jahriyyah vs. al-khafiyyah) by emphasizing sincerity (ikhlas) and protection from ostentation (riya'). It underscores that while public giving is commendable, secret giving to the poor yields greater reward and serves as an expiation for sins, reflecting God's omniscience (khabir) regarding the inner state of the giver.
